items.title: MGM Q2 Deep Dive: Las Vegas, Macau, and Digital Expansion Shape Outlook
items.summary: Hospitality and casino entertainment company MGM Resorts (NYSE:MGM) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 1% year on year to $4.45 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.59 per share was 1.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: MGM Resorts (MGM) Stock Looks Undervalued On Cash Flow While Earnings Look Overvalued
items.summary: MGM Resorts International stock has returned 24.7% over the past year, yet the valuation checks send mixed signals as the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate points to upside while traditional market multiples lean the other way. With an active take‑private proposal in the background and the shares last closing at US$44.57, investors are weighing whether the current price already reflects the main pieces of the story.
